reason: Owner requested starting with 32 parallel agents and checking whether further acceleration is feasible. A ten-minute 32-agent window had no failed attempts or OOM kills and ample spare server memory. Trial 40 aggregate agents while retaining all case and per-attempt settings.
resumption: Original Hermes scheduler drains already-started attempts before replacement; completed statuses and original run IDs retained. No active attempt is interrupted or retried.
interpretation: Operational throughput comparison across calendar windows, not randomized; changing model/case mix and provider load confound observed speedup. Trial may be reverted to aggregate32 if throughput or reliability worsens.
